walkthrough:
Use the arc length formula $s = r\theta$ with $s = 6\text{ cm}$ and $\theta = \frac{3\pi}{8}\text{ radians}$:
$$6 = OA \times \frac{3\pi}{8}$$

Solve for the radius $OA$ to 4 significant figures:
$$OA = \frac{6 \times 8}{3\pi} = \frac{16}{\pi} \approx 5.09296 \approx 5.093\text{ cm}$$

hints: In right $\triangle OAB$, $\angle AOB = \frac{3\pi}{16} \implies AB = OA \tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{16}\right) \approx 3.403\text{ cm}$.
walkthrough:
By symmetry, the line $OB$ bisects the angle $\angle AOC$:
$$\angle AOB = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right) = \frac{3\pi}{16}\text{ radians}$$

In the right-angled triangle $\triangle OAB$ ($AB \perp OA$):
$$AB = OA \tan\left(\frac{3\pi}{16}\right) = 5.09296 \times \tan(0.58905) \approx 5.09296 \times 0.66818 \approx 3.40299\text{ cm}$$

Calculate the perimeter of the shaded region (bounded by tangents $AB, CB$ and arc $AC$):
$$\text{Perimeter} = AB + BC + \text{Arc } AC = 2(3.40299) + 6 = 6.806 + 6 = 12.806 \approx 12.8\text{ cm} \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$

hints: Subtract sector area from quadrilateral area.
walkthrough:
Calculate the total area of the kite/quadrilateral $OABC$ (composed of two congruent right triangles $\triangle OAB$ and $\triangle OCB$):
$$\text{Area}(OABC) = 2 \times \left(\frac{1}{2} \times OA \times AB\right) = OA \times AB = 5.09296 \times 3.40299 \approx 17.3313\text{ cm}^2$$

Calculate the area of sector $OAC$:
$$\text{Area}(\text{sector } OAC) = \frac{1}{2}r^2\theta = \frac{1}{2}(5.09296)^2\left(\frac{3\pi}{8}\right) \approx 15.2789\text{ cm}^2$$

Subtract the sector area from the quadrilateral area to find the shaded area:
$$\text{Shaded Area} = \text{Area}(OABC) - \text{Area}(\text{sector } OAC) = 17.3313 - 15.2789 = 2.0524 \approx 2.05\text{ cm}^2 \quad (\text{to 3 s.f.})$$
